title: NovaLabs Cookie Settings
description: Public manifest of cookies used by the NovaLabs web application. This file is crawlable and intended to be picked up by GDPR transparency scanners; it MUST NOT contain visitor-specific values.

strictlyNecessary.description: Cookies required for the application to function. These cannot be disabled because the site cannot operate without them (authentication, CSRF protection). They are set on a legitimate-interest basis under GDPR Art. 6(1)(f).

cookies.name: authAccessToken
cookies.purpose: Holds the user's JWT access token as an HttpOnly cookie so the backend can authenticate the request without client-side JS.

cookies.name: authRefreshToken
cookies.purpose: Holds the user's refresh-token JWT as an HttpOnly cookie scoped to /api/auth/refresh-token so the access token can be renewed without prompting the user.

cookies.name: csrf
cookies.purpose: Synchronizer CSRF token — must match the x-csrf-token header on every state-changing request.

analytics.description: Cookies used to measure aggregated, anonymised usage of the site. Disabled by default. Only set after the user clicks 'Accept' on the cookie banner.

cookies.name: cookie_consent
cookies.purpose: Stores the user's consent choice so the banner is not shown again on subsequent visits.

marketing.description: Cookies used to deliver targeted marketing or to measure ad performance. NovaLabs does not currently set any cookies in this category.

consent.lawfulBasis: GDPR Art. 6(1)(a) consent / Art. 6(1)(f) legitimate interest
consent.withdrawalMethod: Click 'Decline' or 'Manage preferences' in the cookie banner at any time — your choice is recorded in the cookie_consent cookie.
